customManagers.description: CI tool pins in scripts/bootstrap.sh and the Renovate pin in the justfile. The sha256 next to a bootstrap pin is not updated: CI fails on the mismatch until it is.

packageRules.description: Automerge patch and minor updates once the gate check is green (the main ruleset requires it). Pin and digest updates stay manual: they change the code that runs without a reviewed version change.
Tool pins with a checksum need a human to update the sha256.
Majors are reviewed by hand, with release notes in the PR.

satteri stays on the minor @astrojs/markdown-satteri declares (^0.10.5), so the diagram plugin and Astro's Markdown processor share one copy and one set of plugin types. Raise the bound when @astrojs/markdown-satteri moves.
Hold TypeScript at 6: astro check (@astrojs/check) and svelte-check do not accept TypeScript 7 yet. Remove this rule when both list ^7 in their typescript peer range.

Keep the security overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml inside the major their parent declares. They patch test and local tooling only, and the newest 7.x of undici and 11.x of uuid already carry the fixes. Remove a rule when its parent depends on a fixed version and the override goes.
@types/node follows the Node major in .node-version (24). Raise this bound in the pull request that moves .node-version to a new major.
Node from .node-version (Workers Builds and mise read it), pnpm and just from mise.toml and packageManager.
